definition: Prevents false truth mutation; preserves evidence, review, approval, promotion, stale/reopen and closure distinctions.
Helps users understand current project state, dependencies, blockers, and uncertainty.
Makes the next required human action, owner, and reason obvious.
Allows users to trace a claim, decision, status, or KPI to exact evidence and audit history.
Explains what changed, what became stale, and why re-review is required.
Supports fast, dense, multi-row review for PM, finance, procurement, and engineering users.
Helps occasional users understand what to do without training in the entire CAPEX model.
Supports task triage, approval, evidence summary, and read-only drilldown on mobile/tablet.
Can be implemented with WCAG-oriented keyboard, screen-reader, reflow, performance, and large-data handling.
Can be built safely as an MVP with understandable APIs, test fixtures, and migration path.
